descriptionHtml:
缺陷 A1 · P2 · 无障碍

按钮 / 输入框 / 下拉框没有可访问名称（养老院的 +、设置、返回、关闭 X、任务完成 / 删除、用药状态下拉等），附带部分焦点跳顶、点按区域太小

票：— · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：本地（视觉巡检）

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：OAT-01/S21, OAT-06/S24b, TC-03/S21, TC-11/S20, TC-12/S20, TC-14/S22, TC-19/S21, TC-22/S20

思路 / Approach · TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · S20 「对两个列表和两个病历的 Pre-Round、Encounter 标签页做 axe 扫描」 axe scan of both lists and both charts' Pre-Round and Encounter tabs

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U5 No Clinic anywhere: absent from the context switcher and from the template picker（UAT TC-21；TFA-92599 AC 4；TFA-92599 AC 9） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • U2 Template list: Hospital offers exactly H&P, SOAP progress, Consult note and Discharge summary; Nursing Home offers exactly SNF admission, SNF follow-up, SNF consult and SNF discharge (not the prototy …（UAT TC-21；UAT TC-21 step 1 (template list)；TFA-92599 AC 1） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • U1e Quick Dictation is available in Hospital and absent in Nursing Home（UAT TC-21 step 1；UAT TC-04） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress

测试设计方法：无障碍（accessibility） — 按读屏、键盘、对比度、点按尺寸的规则（axe）查，残障用户也要能用。

Given visual-lane fixture, desktop Chrome, Pixel 7 and iPhone 15 (WebKit)

When visual-lane.ts opens /rounding, /snf, both charts' Pre-Round and Encounter tabs (closed Note Format select) and the NH handoff, and runs axe

Then No WCAG 2 A/AA violations; the switcher buttons have accessible names

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：axe-core WCAG 2 A/AA findings from visual-checks.ts, reported for a human (report.mjs / to-allure 'needs-human'), not Pass/Fail

在哪跑：本地 visual lane（截图 + axe）；测试方法 VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；矩阵里排的车道 视觉 / 移动端（automated）

S20 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-21.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条；Allure 状态按分诊从 passed 改成 failed。

问题分类：无障碍 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92599 in progress

养老院页面的「+」、设置和返回按钮没有可读名称，医院病人卡片里按钮套按钮，所有列表和病历页都有对比度不达 AA 的文字。

On the Nursing Home screens the '+', Settings and back buttons have no accessible name, the Hospital patient card nests buttons inside a button, and text contrast fails AA on every list and chart screen.

依据：allure-results/15254a57…: the report shows 通过 because the oracle makes axe record-only, but the result carries axe findings: a critical button-name violation on the NH header '+' / Settings / back, a serious nested-interactive violation on the Hospital card, and AA contrast failures on every screen. An EFS risk predicted the unnamed NH buttons. It is included here even though it is not non-pass.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane visual。

测试方法：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：visual。

UAT item: TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-21/S20

axe scan of both lists and both charts' Pre-Round and Encounter tabs

Tickets: TFA-92599 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch (in progress)

本地新 lane visual：visual/results.json 里 status record-only → 通过（只记录（判过的都通过；带一个待定的产品问题，写在说明里））。

怎么测（visual/plan.json，automatable: yes）：lists.spec.ts: both lists, both charts' Pre-Round and Encounter, NH handoff; context-switcher names judged; axe recorded for a person (oracle says not Pass/Fail). [2026-10-14 review] Record-only (oracle: 'reported for a human … not Pass/Fail'); the switcher-name check is kept as an unjudged value. ai/assist:generateHandoff is answered 'ok' at the socket (as OAT-06/S24b does) so the NH handoff under axe is the normal screen, not the 'couldn't be generated' fallback.

Detail:

desktop, iphone15, pixel7: record-only (oracle: axe findings reported for a human, not Pass/Fail). Then-clause checks evaluated, not judged: 6 held, 0 did not. Record-only per the oracle ('reported for a human … not Pass/Fail'). The context switcher buttons are named 'Hospital' and 'Nursing Home' (then-clause check held, not judged). The NH handoff is now captured with ai/assist:generateHandoff answered 'ok' at the socket, so axe sees the normal handoff screen. axe findings on the lists, both charts and the NH handoff are recorded for a person: contrast on every screen, NH '+'/Settings/back unnamed (button-name, critical), Hospital card nested-interactive (serious).

产品问题：Routed for a person (record-only): the axe findings above — critical button-name on the NH header '+' / Settings / back, serious nested-interactive on the Hospital card, AA contrast on every screen (then: 'No WCAG 2 A/AA violations').

证据：附了 9 个；没附 1 个：

  • visual/evidence/TC-21_S20 — 目录（45 项），不附

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane V: visual-lane.ts reads a make-session.ts fixture (a fresh local account made with the admin key), and make-session.ts refuses dev, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
